author: IGN
description:
Unlike The Witcher 4, which has moved to Unreal Engine 5, The Witcher 3 Remastered sticks with CD Projekt Red’s own Red Engine, with more additions than a mage’s alchemy pot. It adds enhanced textures, improved foliage and Level of detail, better lighting with Ray and Path Tracing, DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction, and much more. However, this huge facelift still has its issues, with Nvidia HairWorks still killing framerates and potentially looking worse. 

Here's our performance review of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered and what we recommend for the optimal settings on PC.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered - PC Performance Review

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Wishlist Trailer for Squadron 42, a cinematic single-player sci-fi adventure game set in the expansive Star Citizen universe. The year is 2945, and the United Empire of Earth stands on the verge of collapse as threats from outlaws and hostile alien forces emerge from the darkest reaches of space. Players enlist as a rookie in the UEE Navy, embarking on a dangerous journey that will take them from a recruit to the heart of a galactic war. Stationed aboard a massive capital ship, they’ll live and work alongside a dynamic crew, forge relationships, and face the sacrifices and split-second decisions that will shape their path forward as they earn their place, their rank, and their legacy. The space epic features a star-studded cast including Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Ben Mendelsohn, Henry Cavill, and more. Squadron 42, is now available to wishlist on Steam ahead of its planned Q2 2027 release.

#ign #gaming
title: Squadron 42 - Official Wishlist Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Enshrouded has changed dramatically since it entered early access in January 2024. Over the past two and a half years, Keen Games has added new regions, weapons, dungeons, building features, farming, pets, weather, swimming, fishing, improved combat, and much more. In this video, we break down the biggest additions to Enshrouded, from the Hollow Halls and Blackmire to the Frozen Frontier, Wake of the Water, and the final major early access update, Forging the Path.

We’ll also look ahead to Enshrouded’s 1.0 release, including the conclusion of the main storyline, new traversal options, quality-of-life improvements, and the long-awaited console release.

Enshrouded leaves early access on October 15, 2026, launching on PC and PS5, with an Xbox Series X|S release coming in Spring 2027.
title: Enshrouded: Every Major Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description: The release of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered brings a ton of quality-of-life additions, but a few cool mods can make your time as Geralt so much better. In this video, we highlight six amazing mods designed to enhance your gameplay, add new features, and make exploring the game more enjoyable, all without feeling like you're cheating. Playthrough the game again with the First-Person Mod, cozy up next to a skeleton and find yourself lost in the lore with the Immersive Book Reader, and tweak the game's graphics seamlessly without constantly opening and closing menus using the Real-Time Graphics Mod. We also showcase a restored Reputation System that tracks your regional standing and impacts the local economy, handy Quest level markers on the map to help organize your quest log, and a hilarious Low-Poly Pigeon mod that turns every griffin fight into a battle against the iconic, low-polygon meme.
title: You Need to Try These Witcher 3 Mods

author: IGN
description:
Marvel Studios and Disney+ are about to debut their newest MCU series, [VisionQuest](https://www.ign.com/tv/visionquest), which seems like a good time to look back at Vision’s quest so far!
In the new series, which is described as the conclusion of a trilogy that also includes WandaVision and Agatha All Along, Vision (Paul Bettany) is spending time inside a virtual world, where he is in contact with AI personas we’ve met before in the MCU, most notably the dreaded Ultron (James Spader). And at the same time, in the real world, Vision comes into contact with a teenager who’s the reincarnation of one of his sons, Tommy.
It’s been a wild journey for the Vision and those he’s closest to, filled with birth, death, rebirth, and sitcom recreations. So let’s look back at the story so far for Vision, Ultron, Tommy and other VisionQuest characters - and potential characters.
title: VisionQuest: The Vision's Story So Far | MCU Recap

author: IGN
description:
It’s fair to say that, across the three games in the reboot series so far, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare’s story has been far from a simple one. With the amount of action happening during each mission, combined with key plot points occurring outside of the core campaigns in places like Warzone’s Verdansk, it can be difficult to keep track. 

Thankfully, we’re here to give you as succinct a summary as we can of the story so far ahead of Modern Warfare 4’s release. With Infinity Ward’s saga set to come to an end imminently, let’s recap how we got here. Warning: may contain a lot of chasing stolen missiles around the world.

This is the complete recap of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare series.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Timeline Recap (Watch Before Modern Warfare 4)

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Official Teaser Trailer for Bloodaxe, an historical action drama distributed by Prime Video. Witness the tale of history’s most famous Norse raiders in Bloodaxe, premiering on January 20, 2027, on Prime Video.

Bloodaxe is an epic historical drama, created, written, and executive produced by Michael and Horatio Hirst, which chronicles the rise of one of history’s most famous Norse raiders, Erik Bloodaxe (Xavier Molyneux), and his formidable wife Gunnhild, Mother of Kings (Jessica Madsen). The series’ highly anticipated first season has yet to debut and will tell the story of their fight for the throne of Norway, as the land is torn apart by fierce rivals, shifting loyalties, and bloody betrayals. With war looming and chaos consuming the kingdom, drawing in the ruthless Kings of other Scandinavian countries, and even a powerful English ruler, the stage is set for a thundering, cataclysmic, compelling, and utterly magical new Norse saga.

Bloodaxe is executive produce
title: Bloodaxe - Official Teaser Trailer (2027) Xavier Molyneux, Jessica Madsen
